title: Linije 1,17,21,22,23,24,30 – Privremena izmena trase u Kisačkoj ulici od 2. 11. (druga faza radova)

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 2.11. do 30.11.2026. godine određuje se privremena izmena trase autobuskih linija broj 1, 17, 21, 22, 22, 23, 24 i 30 zbog radova u Kisačkoj ulici, na delu od Ulice Jovana Cvijića do Bulevara kralja Petra I.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, dated 2.11. until 30.11.2026. 1, 17, 21, 22, 22, 23, 24 and 30, due to works in Kisačka Street, on the part from Jovana Cvijić Street to Kralja Petar I Boulevard.

sections.text: LINIJA 1

text_translations.en: LINE 1

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Kisačka/Jovana Cvijića autobusi će skretati levo u Ulicu Jovana Cvijića, desno u Temerinsku ulicu i produžavati pravo u Ulicu Jovana Subotića, odakle će nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the Kisačka/Jovan Cvijić intersection, buses will turn left into Jovana Cvijić Street, right into Temerinska Street and continue straight into Jovana Subotić Street, from where they will continue on their regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENjENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE STAJALIŠTE  „TEMERINSKA PIJACA“.

text_translations.en: ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE, THE "TEMERINSKA PIJACA" STOP WILL BE USED.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Temerinska/Jovana Cvijića autobusi će skretati levo u Ulicu  Jovana Cvijića i desno Kisačkom ulicom nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the Temerinska/Jovan Cvijić intersection, buses will turn left into Jovana Cvijić Street and continue right along Kisačka Street along the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENjENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE STAJALIŠTE  „TEMERINSKA – TRG MARIJE TRANDAFIL“.

text_translations.en: THE "TEMERINSKA - MARIJE TRANDAFIL SQUARE" STOP WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

sections.text: LINIJA 17

text_translations.en: LINE 17

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Kisačka/Jovana Cvijića autobusi će skretati levo u Ulicu Jovana Cvijića, desno u Temerinsku ulici i produžavati pravo u Ulicu Jovana Subotića, odakle će nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the Kisačka/Jovan Cvijić intersection, buses will turn left into Jovana Cvijić Street, right into Temerinska Street and continue straight into Jovana Subotić Street, from where they will continue on their regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE STAJALIŠTE  „TEMERINSKA PIJACA“.

text_translations.en: ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE, THE "TEMERIN MARKET" STOP WILL BE USED.

sections.text: Redovna trasa.

text_translations.en: Regular route.

sections.text: Sa platoa ispred železničke stanice autobusi će skretati levo na Bulevar Jaše Tomića, levo u Kisačku ulicu, desno u Partizansku, raskrsnici Partizanska/Temerinska produžavaće pravo Putem šajkaškog odreda i nastavljati redovnim trasama.

text_translations.en: From the plateau in front of the railway station, the buses will turn left onto Bulevar Jaša Tomić, left into Kisačka Street, right into Partizanska, the Partizanska/Temerinska intersection will continue straight along the Šajka Detachment Road and continue on regular routes.

sections.text: Autobusi će saobraćati redovnim trasama do raskrsnice Partizanska/Temerinska, odakle će produžavati pravo Partizanskom ulicom, skretati levo u Kisačku ulicu, desno na Bulevar Jaše Tomića do železničke stanice.

text_translations.en: Buses will run on regular routes to the intersection of Partizanska/Temerinska, from where they will continue straight along Partizanska Street, turn left into Kisačka Street, right onto Bulevar Jaše Tomić to the train station.

sections.text: NA IZMENjENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆA AUTOBUSKA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA.

text_translations.en: EXISTING BUS STOPS OF OTHER LINES WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

sections.text: LINIJA 30

text_translations.en: LINE 30

sections.text: Polazno stajalište Bulevar Jaše Tomića, odakle će autobusi skretati levo u Kisačku ulicu, desno u Partizansku, levo u Temerinsku ulicu i nastavljati redovnom trasom za Pejićeve salaše.

text_translations.en: Departure stop Bulevar Jaša Tomić, from where the buses will turn left into Kisačka ulica, right into Partizanska ulica, left into Temerinska ulica and continue on the regular route to Pejićeve salaše.

sections.text: Autobusi će saobraćati redovnom trasom do raskrsnice Partizanska/Temerinska, skretaće desno u Partizansku ulicu, levo u Kisačku ulicu, desno na Bulevar Jaše Tomića do železničke stanice.

text_translations.en: Buses will run on the regular route to the Partizanska/Temerinska intersection, turn right into Partizanska Street, left into Kisačka Street, right onto Bulevar Jaše Tomić to the train station.

sections.text: NA IZMENjENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆA AUTOBUSKA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA.

text_translations.en: EXISTING BUS STOPS OF OTHER LINES WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

title: Linije 1,8,17,21,22,23,24,30 - Privremena izmena trase u Kisačkoj ulici

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve (broj: IV-34-7405/26 od 19.10.2026.g.) određuje se privremena izmena trase autobuskih linija broj 1, 8, 17, 21, 22, 22, 23, 24 i 30 zbog radova u Kisačkoj ulici, na delu saobraćajnice od Ulice Jovana Cvijića do Bulevara kralja Petra I. Izmenjen režim saobraćanja linija važi od 20.10.2026. do 31.10.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads (number: IV-34-7405/26 of October 19, 2026), a temporary change in the route of bus lines number 1, 8, 17, 21, 22, 22, 23, 24 and 30 is determined due to works in Kisačka Street, on the part of the road from Jovana Cvijić Street to Kralja Petar I Boulevard. The changed mode of traffic of the lines is valid from 20.10.2026. until 31.10.2026. year.

text_translations.en: From the Kisačka/Jovan Cvijić intersection, buses turn left into Jovana Cvijić Street, right onto Temerinska Street, from where they continue straight into Jovana Subotić Street and continue along the regular route.

title: Linije 6, 11A, 11B – Privremena izmena trase u Ulici Marka Miljanova

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve o zatvaranju dela Ulice Marka Miljanova, zbog radova na toplovodu od 13. 10. godine privremeno će biti izmenjene trase autobuskih linija broj 11A i 11B, a od 14. 10. trasa linije broj 6.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads on the closure of a part of Marka Miljanova Street, the routes of bus lines 11A and 11B will be temporarily changed from 10.13., and from 10.14.

sections.text: Predviđeno je da radovi traju do 16. 11. 2026. godine.

text_translations.en: It is planned that the works will last until November 16, 2026.

text_translations.en: LINE 6

text_translations.en: Direction Podba

text_translations.en: Buses will turn right from Filipa Višnjić Street to Venizelosova Street, right past Kvantaš to the roundabout, left to Marka Miljanova Street, right to Belgrade Quay and continue on the regular route.

text_translations.en: Buses will continue straight on Belgrade Quay and after the road-railway bridge will turn left into Venizelosova Street, right into Temerinska Street, left into Partizanska Street, left into Kisačka Street, right onto Jaše Tomić Boulevard and continue along the regular route.

title: Ukidaju se vanredni polasci do i od Železničke stanice Petrovaradin

sections.text: Nakon otvaranja železničkog stajališta na Rumenačkom putu i rasterećenja Železničke stanice Petrovaradin, raskinut je ugovor između „Srbijavoza“ i JGSP „Novi Sad“ o organizovanju besplatnih vanrednih polazaka autobusa na relaciji Šafarikova ulica – Železnička stanica Petrovaradin.

text_translations.en: After the opening of the railway stop on Rumenački put and the relief of Petrovaradin Railway Station, the contract between "Srbijavoza" and JGSP "Novi Sad" on organizing free emergency bus departures on the route Šafarikova Street - Petrovaradin Railway Station was terminated.

sections.text: Shodno tome, od 12. oktobra ukidaju se vanredni direktni polasci autobusa sa redovnog stajališta „Petrovaradin – Železnička stanica“, u Preradovićevoj ulici, do terminala u Šafarikovoj ulici u centru Novog Sada (oba smera).

text_translations.en: Accordingly, as of October 12, extraordinary direct bus departures from the regular "Petrovaradin - Railway Station" stop in Preradovićeva Street to the terminal in Šafarikova Street in the center of Novi Sad will be canceled (both directions).

sections.text: Putnici i dalje mogu da koriste redovne polaske na linijama 3, 9, 9A, 60, 61, 62 i 63 za dolazak do Železničke stanice Petrovaradin.

text_translations.en: Passengers can still use regular departures on lines 3, 9, 9A, 60, 61, 62 and 63 to get to Petrovaradin Railway Station.

title_translations.en: Extraordinary departures to and from Petrovaradin Railway Station are cancelled

title: Linija 4 produžena do železničkog stajališta Rumenački put

sections.text: Od 7. oktobra  trasa linije 4 produžava se do Rumenačkog puta, čime je građanima omogućena direktna veza javnim prevozom do železničkog stajališta Rumenački put.

text_translations.en: From October 7th, the route of line 4 is extended to Rumenački put, which enables citizens to have a direct connection by public transport to the railway stop Rumenački put.

sections.text: Autobusi na liniji će sa Bulevara oslobođenja nastavljati Bulevarom Jaše Tomića, Rumenačkom ulicom i Rumenačkim putem do železničkog stajališta Rumenački put. Ista trasa koristi se i u suprotnom smeru.

text_translations.en: Buses on the line will continue from the Boulevard of Liberation to the Boulevard of Jaša Tomić, Rumenački street and Rumenački put to the railway stop Rumenački put. The same route is used in the opposite direction.

sections.text: Na produženom delu trase koriste se postojeća stajališta, a uvedeno je i novo stajalište u okviru parking zone železničkog stajališta Rumenački put.

text_translations.en: On the extended part of the route, the existing stops are used, and a new stop was introduced within the parking zone of the Rumenački put railway station.

sections.text: Sa izmenom trase promenjen je i naziv linije, koja sada saobraća pod nazivom LIMAN 4 – CENTAR – Železnička stanica (Rumenački put).

text_translations.en: With the change of the route, the name of the line was also changed, which now runs under the name LIMAN 4 - CENTAR - Railway station (Rumenački put).

sections.text: Produžavanjem linije 4 unapređuje se povezanost nove Železničke stanice sa centralnim gradskim područjem, kao i sa drugim važnim gradskim pravcima. Linija povezuje više značajnih odredišta, među kojima su Futoška pijaca, Bulevar Mihajla Pupina i područje Novosadskog univerziteta.

text_translations.en: The extension of line 4 improves the connection of the new railway station with the central city area, as well as with other important city routes. The line connects several important destinations, including the Futoška market, Mihajla Pupina Boulevard and the area of ​​the University of Novi Sad.

sections.text: Izmena trase doprinosi boljoj dostupnosti javnog prevoza za građane koji koriste železnički prevoz, a dodatno unapređuje prevoznu uslugu za stanovnike Avijatičarskog naselja i mogućnosti putovanja ka Univerzitetu.

text_translations.en: The route change contributes to better availability of public transport for citizens who use rail transport, and additionally improves the transport service for the residents of Avijatičarski settlement and the possibility of traveling to the University.

sections.text: Pored linije 4, do novog železničkog stajališta Rumenački put građani mogu da koriste i linije 5, 14, 41, 42 i 43.

text_translations.en: In addition to line 4, citizens can also use lines 5, 14, 41, 42 and 43 to reach the new railway stop Rumenački put.

title_translations.en: Line 4 extended to the railway stop Rumenački put

title: Linije 5, 10 APT, 14, 41, 42, 43 – Privremeno ukidanje stajališta RUMENAČKA – RADNIČKO IGRALIŠTE

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske Uprave za saobraćaj i puteve Grada Novog Sada, od 9. 9. 2026. godine do završetka radova privremeno će biti ukinuto autobusko stajalište Rumenačka – Radničko igralište zbog izvođenja građevinskih radova. Navedeno stajalište koriste linije broj 5, 10 APT, 14, 41, 42, 43 – smer ka Sajlovu).

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads of the City of Novi Sad, from September 9, 2026, until the completion of the works, the bus stop Rumenačka - Radničko igraštet will be temporarily closed due to construction works. The mentioned stop is used by lines number 5, 10 APT, 14, 41, 42, 43 - direction to Saylov).

title_translations.en: Lines 5, 10 APT, 14, 41, 42, 43 - Temporary cancellation of the stop RUMENAČKA - RADNIČKO IGRALISTE

title: Linije 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 i 71vmč – Privremena izmena trasa u Ulici Maksima Gorkog

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, određuje se privremena izmena trase autobuskih linija broj 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 i 71vmč  zbog izvođenja radova na rekonstrukciji kolektora kanalizacione mreže  u Maksima Gorkog, od Stražilovske ulice do Sutjeske ulice u Novom Sadu. Izmenjen  režim saobraćnja linija važi u periodu od 7. 9. do 20. 11. 2026. godine.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, a temporary change in the route of bus lines number 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 and 71vmč is determined due to the performance of works on the reconstruction of the sewer network collector in Maksim Gorko, from Stražilovska Street to Sutjeska Street in Novi Sad. Izmenjen  režim saobraćnja linija važi u periodu od 7. 9. do 20. 11. 2026. godine.

sections.text: LINIJA 12

text_translations.en: LINE 12

sections.text: Autobusi saobraćaju redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: Buses operate on a regular route.

sections.text: Autobusi na raskrsnici Bulevar oslobođenja/Ulice Maksima Gorkog produžavaju pravo Bulevarom oslobođenja, skreću desno u Jevrejsku ulicu, levo u Uspensku ulicu i dalje nastavljaju redovnom trasom.

title_translations.en: Lines 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 and 71 vmč - Temporary change of routes in Maksima Gorki Street

sections.text:
Autobusi JGSP „Novi Sad“ od 1. septembra saobraćaće po novom redu vožnje, koji u odnosu na letnji red vožnje podrazumeva veći broj polazaka.

O vremenskim korekcijama polazaka korisnici usluga mogu da se informišu u rubrici RED VOŽNJE, kao i putem aplikacije NSMART, te na prodajnim mestima preduzeća.

Od 1. septembra ponovo će na snazi biti polasci koji su u redu vožnje označeni kao „đački“.

text_translations.en:
From September 1, JGSP "Novi Sad" buses will operate according to a new timetable, which, compared to the summer timetable, implies a greater number of departures.

Service users can be informed about time corrections of departures in the section RED VOZNJE, as well as through the NSMART application and at the company's sales points.

From September 1, the departures marked as "pupil" in the timetable will be valid again.
